meta.name: Power Rangers Wild Force
meta.description: Five teenagers are chosen by five Power Animals to become the Wild Force Rangers, to fight the evil Jinderax and Toxica and their evil Orgs.

videos.name: Lionheart
videos.overview: A young man raised in the jungle travels to the city of Turtle Cove and discovers an island - home to legendary beasts from an ancient civilization - floating in the sky above the city.
videos.description: A young man raised in the jungle travels to the city of Turtle Cove and discovers an island - home to legendary beasts from an ancient civilization - floating in the sky above the city.

videos.name: Darkness Awakening
videos.overview: Cole seeks to reason with the Orgs while Jindrax and Toxica discover that after 3000 years the Master Org has returned to Earth again.
videos.description: Cole seeks to reason with the Orgs while Jindrax and Toxica discover that after 3000 years the Master Org has returned to Earth again.

videos.name: Click, Click, Zoom
videos.overview: Cole learns about the secret history of the Animarium while Taylor struggles to accept his leadership.
videos.description: Cole learns about the secret history of the Animarium while Taylor struggles to accept his leadership.

videos.name: Never Give Up
videos.overview: Danny and Max's close friendship is strained by the return of Danny's old crush.
videos.description: Danny and Max's close friendship is strained by the return of Danny's old crush.

videos.name: Ancient Awakening
videos.overview: On a university field trip to some local caves, Alyssa discovers an ancient relic from the Kingdom of Animaria.
videos.description: On a university field trip to some local caves, Alyssa discovers an ancient relic from the Kingdom of Animaria.

videos.name: Wishes on the Water
videos.overview: Max writes a wish on a note inside a bottle and throws it into Turtle Lake but when the Ship Org appears with the bottle stuck to his body, Max worries others will discover what he wished for.
videos.description: Max writes a wish on a note inside a bottle and throws it into Turtle Lake but when the Ship Org appears with the bottle stuck to his body, Max worries others will discover what he wished for.

videos.name: The Bear Necessities
videos.overview: Taylor helps out two mysterious twin boys while reflecting on how she became the first Wild Force Ranger.
videos.description: Taylor helps out two mysterious twin boys while reflecting on how she became the first Wild Force Ranger.

videos.name: Soul Searching
videos.overview: Cole searches for the Soul Bird to heal the injured Red Lion Zord and comes face to face with Master Org, a man he does not remember but has met before.
videos.description: Cole searches for the Soul Bird to heal the injured Red Lion Zord and comes face to face with Master Org, a man he does not remember but has met before.

videos.name: Soul Bird Salvation
videos.overview: Master Org's old bodyguard Retinax fights the Power Rangers to restore his lost honor.
videos.description: Master Org's old bodyguard Retinax fights the Power Rangers to restore his lost honor.

videos.name: Curse of the Wolf
videos.overview: The General Org Nayzor unseals an ancient tomb, freeing a cursed warrior with the face of a wolf.
videos.description: The General Org Nayzor unseals an ancient tomb, freeing a cursed warrior with the face of a wolf.

videos.name: Battle of the Zords
videos.overview: Zen-Aku battles the Rangers with his own evil Wild Zords.
videos.description: Zen-Aku battles the Rangers with his own evil Wild Zords.

videos.name: Predazord, Awaken
videos.overview: Jindrax and Toxica hijack a bus full of innocents to coerce Max into giving up his Animal Crystal.
videos.description: Jindrax and Toxica hijack a bus full of innocents to coerce Max into giving up his Animal Crystal.

videos.name: Revenge of Zen-Aku
videos.overview: Taylor and the Rangers rally to rescue Princess Shayla from Zen-Aku.
videos.description: Taylor and the Rangers rally to rescue Princess Shayla from Zen-Aku.

videos.name: Identity Crisis
videos.overview: Worried that Zen-Aku's memory is returning to him, Nayzor coerces him into attacking the Power Rangers with their own Zords.
videos.description: Worried that Zen-Aku's memory is returning to him, Nayzor coerces him into attacking the Power Rangers with their own Zords.

videos.name: The Ancient Warrior
videos.overview: The Rangers learn Zen-Aku's true identity and how he became an evil warrior for the Orgs.
videos.description: The Rangers learn Zen-Aku's true identity and how he became an evil warrior for the Orgs.

videos.name: The Lone Wolf
videos.overview: The ancient Animarian warrior Merrick fights to atone for his past misdeeds.
videos.description: The ancient Animarian warrior Merrick fights to atone for his past misdeeds.

videos.name: Power Play
videos.overview: The mysterious new Org General Necronomica fights the Rangers while Merrick finds a new home.
videos.description: The mysterious new Org General Necronomica fights the Rangers while Merrick finds a new home.

videos.name: Secrets and Lies
videos.overview: Alyssa helps Cole search for information on his long-lost parents while Master Org tries to hide his past from Jindrax and Toxica.
videos.description: Alyssa helps Cole search for information on his long-lost parents while Master Org tries to hide his past from Jindrax and Toxica.

videos.name: The Tornado Spin
videos.overview: Max tries to regain the respect of his former bowling mentor in order to help him defeat a peculiar new Org.
videos.description: Max tries to regain the respect of his former bowling mentor in order to help him defeat a peculiar new Org.

videos.name: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: Danny competes with a wealthy rival for Kendall while preventing the Wedding Dress Org from capturing Turtle Cove's brides to be.
videos.description: Danny competes with a wealthy rival for Kendall while preventing the Wedding Dress Org from capturing Turtle Cove's brides to be.

videos.name: A Father's Footsteps
videos.overview: Alyssa must rely on her martial arts heritage when the Rangers come up against Samurai Org.
videos.description: Alyssa must rely on her martial arts heritage when the Rangers come up against Samurai Org.

videos.name: Sing Song
videos.overview: The especially powerful Tombstone Org tries to send the Rangers six feet under while Merrick and the Princess try to appease the only Zord capable of saving them.
videos.description: The especially powerful Tombstone Org tries to send the Rangers six feet under while Merrick and the Princess try to appease the only Zord capable of saving them.

videos.name: The Wings of Animaria
videos.overview: Nayzor returns more powerful than ever requiring the Rangers to quest across time and space to find a new Zord's help.
videos.description: Nayzor returns more powerful than ever requiring the Rangers to quest across time and space to find a new Zord's help.

videos.name: Reinforcements from the Future (1)
videos.overview: The Wild Force Rangers join forces with the Silver Guardians to stop three time-traveling monsters from the year 3001.
videos.description: The Wild Force Rangers join forces with the Silver Guardians to stop three time-traveling monsters from the year 3001.

videos.name: Reinforcements from the Future (2)
videos.overview: The Power Ranges Time Force travel back in time to help the Power Rangers Wild Force prevent the three Mut-Orgs from joining forces with Master Org.
videos.description: The Power Ranges Time Force travel back in time to help the Power Rangers Wild Force prevent the three Mut-Orgs from joining forces with Master Org.

videos.name: The Master's Last Stand
videos.overview: Cole learns the truth about his parents when Master Org reveals his sinister origin to the Wild Force Rangers.
videos.description: Cole learns the truth about his parents when Master Org reveals his sinister origin to the Wild Force Rangers.

videos.name: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Merrick must confront a demon from his past when Zen-Aku returns to claim his soul.
videos.description: Merrick must confront a demon from his past when Zen-Aku returns to claim his soul.

videos.name: Homecoming
videos.overview: Cole must protect Kite, a young boy alone in the city, as Mandilok, the new Org General, discovers a taste for new buildings.
videos.description: Cole must protect Kite, a young boy alone in the city, as Mandilok, the new Org General, discovers a taste for new buildings.

videos.name: The Flute
videos.overview: Princess Shayla and Merrick argue as the Flute Org's music ruins their song, causing the Rangers to dance uncontrollably.
videos.description: Princess Shayla and Merrick argue as the Flute Org's music ruins their song, causing the Rangers to dance uncontrollably.

videos.name: Team Carnival
videos.overview: While Max and Taylor help Kite look for his home, they are attacked by Jindrax and his brother Juggelo at an amusement park.
videos.description: While Max and Taylor help Kite look for his home, they are attacked by Jindrax and his brother Juggelo at an amusement park.

videos.name: Taming of the Zords
videos.overview: The Lion Tamer Org takes control of the Wild Zords and turns them against the Rangers.
videos.description: The Lion Tamer Org takes control of the Wild Zords and turns them against the Rangers.

videos.name: Monitoring Earth
videos.overview: Kite finally remembers his past as he grows dissatisfied with mankind's disregard for nature.
videos.description: Kite finally remembers his past as he grows dissatisfied with mankind's disregard for nature.

videos.name: The Soul of Humanity
videos.overview: Without Princess Shayla or the Wild Zords, the Rangers still refuse to give up in their fight to save the world.
videos.description: Without Princess Shayla or the Wild Zords, the Rangers still refuse to give up in their fight to save the world.

videos.name: Forever Red
videos.overview: Ten Red Rangers from ten different teams unite to stop the Machine Empire from using Serpenterra to destroy Earth.
videos.description: Ten Red Rangers from ten different teams unite to stop the Machine Empire from using Serpenterra to destroy Earth.

videos.name: The Master's Herald (1)
videos.overview: The Duke Org Onikage arrives in the Nexus with a plan to infiltrate the Rangers' Animarium and capture Princess Shayla.
videos.description: The Duke Org Onikage arrives in the Nexus with a plan to infiltrate the Rangers' Animarium and capture Princess Shayla.

videos.name: The Master's Herald (2)
videos.overview: The Power Rangers fight across dimensions to try and rescue Princess Shayla from the returning Master Org.
videos.description: The Power Rangers fight across dimensions to try and rescue Princess Shayla from the returning Master Org.

videos.name: Fishing for a Friend
videos.overview: The Rangers receive help from an unlikely source in their battle against the powerful Locomotive Org, as Jindrax plots to bring back his friend.
videos.description: The Rangers receive help from an unlikely source in their battle against the powerful Locomotive Org, as Jindrax plots to bring back his friend.

videos.name: Sealing the Nexus
videos.overview: Jindrax and Toxica team up with the Rangers in order to rescue the Princess and destroy the Nexus once and for all.
videos.description: Jindrax and Toxica team up with the Rangers in order to rescue the Princess and destroy the Nexus once and for all.

videos.name: The End of the Power Rangers (1)
videos.overview: With no more villains to fight, the Rangers realize that their time as super heroes is finally at an end. Meanwhile, in the remains of the Nexus, a new threat emerges to threaten the Earth and the Animarium.
videos.description: With no more villains to fight, the Rangers realize that their time as super heroes is finally at an end. Meanwhile, in the remains of the Nexus, a new threat emerges to threaten the Earth and the Animarium.

videos.name: The End of the Power Rangers (2)
videos.overview: Master Org's destruction of nature continues unchecked while the Power Rangers fight a last desperate battle for the Earth. Good and evil collide in a final battle between the forces of Animaria and the Orgs.
videos.description: Master Org's destruction of nature continues unchecked while the Power Rangers fight a last desperate battle for the Earth. Good and evil collide in a final battle between the forces of Animaria and the Orgs.
